title: Clearer facts after your game
body:
- Improved local question explanations with readable stored facts, comparisons, and reference entities.
- Kept factual explanations and source evidence hidden in active games and available after the game ends.
- Replaced unverified question feedback with safe guidance without exposing provider facts or target-bearing rewrites.
- Preserved the one-second question animation minimum and faster English templates.

Game rules, saved progress, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
